Humaan CLI 0.1.0-alpha.1

An early alpha of Humaan's local, offline command-line tools for managing robot experiences. No cloud account or local server is required. This release establishes the CLI baseline in humaan-ai/humaan; Studio is distributed separately.

Available workflows
- Initialize a named project in the current directory with `humaan project init <name>` and inspect its identity with `humaan project show`.
- Import Humaan v1 recordings or complete local LeRobot v3.0 datasets with `humaan import <path>`. Format detection is automatic; each LeRobot episode becomes an experience.
- Browse experiences with `humaan list` and inspect artifacts and episode provenance with `humaan inspect <id>`.
- Check artifact sizes and SHA-256 checksums. `humaan verify` reports all damaged entries without changing recordings and exits nonzero when verification fails.
- Export original recording artifacts and their manifest with `humaan export <id> <destination>`.
- Use `--json` for machine-readable output and `--store <path>` to select a recording store explicitly.
- See activity indicators and elapsed time during interactive recording operations. Indicators are disabled for JSON output and redirected stderr.

Downloads
- macOS Apple Silicon: `humaan-cli_0.1.0-alpha.1_macos_arm64.tar.gz`.
- Linux x86-64: `humaan-cli_0.1.0-alpha.1_linux_x86_64.tar.gz`.
- Windows x86-64: `humaan-cli_0.1.0-alpha.1_windows_x86_64.zip`.

Use the archive and accompanying SHA-256 manifest for your platform. Extract the archive and add the directory containing `humaan` (or `humaan.exe`) to your PATH. Confirm installation with `humaan --version` and `humaan --help`. Windows executables are unsigned. Linux packages are built on Ubuntu 22.04; compatibility depends on the host runtime.

Quick start
Run these commands in the directory you want to use as your project. Replace the recording path and experience ID with your own values:

```sh
humaan project init my-robot
humaan project show
humaan import /path/to/recording
humaan list
humaan inspect EXPERIENCE_ID --json
humaan verify
humaan export EXPERIENCE_ID ./exported-recording
```

Compatibility and limitations
- Projects and Humaan recordings use version 1 formats. Interfaces and formats may change during alpha; back up project directories before upgrading.
- LeRobot import supports complete v3.0 datasets only. Partial downloads, episode subsets, and other LeRobot versions are not supported.
- Import validates dataset structure and referenced files, but does not validate video decoding, sensor alignment, physical units, or training suitability.
- Imported shared chunks are immutable. Editing one can affect multiple experiences; checksum verification detects changes. Duplicate imports and exports to existing destinations are rejected.
- Export preserves referenced chunks and episode provenance. It does not trim shared videos or produce a standalone LeRobot training dataset.
- Batch import publication is not crash-atomic across all episodes. Avoid interrupting publication or modifying the store concurrently.
- Live hardware capture, cloud storage, simulation, training, and dataset-preparation commands are not exposed by this CLI.
